page.overview:
What is In My Life?

In My Life is a song by The Beatles, written by John Lennon, and credited to Lennon/McCartney. It is often ranked amongst the best Beatles songs by fans and critics, and it has been voted [http://www.btoe.com/lists/best-song-on-earth Best Song On Earth] by music fans.

With lovers and friends I still can recall

I know I'll often stop and think about them

I know I'll often stop and think about them
